name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
Prediction markets price Moore near certain to win
Republican challenger has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 leans Democratic by 26 points and Gwen Moore is a well-established incumbent, while the Republican challenger shows no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets price Moore's chances near certain, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly well-funded challenger could narrow the margin, though a Moore loss remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Wisconsin's 4th District, centered on Milwaukee, is one of the most Democratic seats in the state, with a partisan lean of about 26 points toward Democrats. Gwen Moore has held the seat since 2005 and is running again after easily securing renomination.

Her Republican challenger, Tim Rogers, has no reported fundraising, and no outside groups are active in the race. Prediction markets put Moore's chances at roughly 96 percent. With no public polling and no expert ratings, the forecast rests on the district's strong Democratic fundamentals, incumbency, and Moore's financial advantage, all pointing to a comfortable Democratic win.
